intro.h2: A Paducah crew that gets your bathroom back fast
paragraphs: Matt's Home Solutions handles bathroom remodeling in Paducah with a small, hands-on crew led by owner Matt Pyles. One family had only one shower in the house, and Matt worked to have them showering at home again in no time.

The same crew does kitchens from the floors up, new flooring, tile, trim and decks. Reviewers keep mentioning the same things: Matt answers messages quickly, the crew is polite, pricing is fair, and the job site is cleaned up before they leave, with leftover flooring stacked neatly out of the way. As one customer put it, Matt and his crew made the remodel a complete breeze.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Paducah, plus kitchens, floors and decks

items.name: Bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Full bathroom remodels, from walk-in tile showers with glass doors to tub and shower updates with new vanities. Matt knows how hard it is when a home's only shower is torn out, so he plans the job to get you back in quickly.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with dark wood vanity, tan solid-surface top, tub with glass shower door and gray plank floor

items.name: Kitchen remodels
items.blurb: Complete kitchen remodels, including subfloor and joist repair, cabinets, countertops, backsplash and flooring. One recent kitchen paired white shaker cabinets with wood-look counters and a stacked stone backsplash, and the owner kept adding extras along the way.

image.alt: Kitchen with white shaker cabinets, wood-look countertops, stacked slate backsplash, stainless range hood and plank flooring

items.name: Flooring and tile
items.blurb: Luxury vinyl plank and tile installed through kitchens, hallways and living rooms. Customers say the crew finished ahead of schedule, hauled off the trash and left the floors clean so the furniture could go straight back in place.

image.alt: Rustic multi-tone wood-look plank flooring installed in a hallway

items.name: Decks, porches and exteriors
items.blurb: Exterior carpentry such as covered porches, deck tear-outs and rebuilds. Matt's business card lists exteriors, trim, roofing and new construction too, so one crew can handle the inside and the outside of the same house.

image.alt: New covered wood porch with railings and stairs built on a manufactured home

items.title: Quick answers
items.text: Google reviewers say Matt always answered messages quickly and did everything in a timely manner. You are not left guessing when the crew will show up.

items.title: A polite, tidy crew
items.text: "Polite crew" is one of the most common themes in the reviews. Customers describe the guys as hard working and professional, and say they clean up all the trash before leaving.

items.title: Fair pricing
items.text: Several reviewers point to fair pricing. One bathroom customer thanked Matt for his attention to detail, fair pricing and professionalism on a total remodel.

items.title: Extras are welcome
items.text: A kitchen customer kept adding extras and Matt never complained. In his own reply he says extras just mean the job is built exactly the way you want it.

about.text: Matt's Home Solutions LLC is run by Matt Pyles out of Paducah, Kentucky. Matt works alongside a small crew he calls "the guys," and he answers his own reviews. In one reply he wrote that he wants people to feel comfortable and confident through the whole process. The company is licensed and insured and takes on interiors and exteriors: bathrooms, kitchens, tile, flooring, trim, roofing and new construction. Every one of its 21 Google reviews so far is five stars.

image.alt: Matt's Home Solutions, LLC logo: blue MHS letters under a house roofline

process.h2: How a remodel with Matt works

steps.title: Call or message
steps.text: Call (270) 349-2054 or email Matt with what you want done. Reviewers say he replies to messages quickly.

steps.title: Walk through the space
steps.text: Matt looks at the room with you and listens to how you want it finished, from countertops to backsplash to flooring.

steps.title: Build it your way
steps.text: The crew does the work, including subfloor or joist repair if needed. Extras you add along the way are part of the job.

steps.title: Clean up and hand over
steps.text: Trash is hauled off, floors are cleaned and leftover materials are stacked out of the way so you can move back in.

service_area.text: Matt's Home Solutions works out of 120 Reid Circle in Paducah, KY, and Paducah is the town named on its Google and Facebook pages. If you live in or around Paducah and need a bathroom, kitchen, flooring or porch project done, call Matt at (270) 349-2054 or send him an email to check whether your home is in range before you book a visit.

items.q: Is Matt's Home Solutions licensed and insured?
items.a: Yes. The company's business card and Facebook graphics state "Licensed & Insured." If you need a copy of the insurance certificate for your HOA or lender, ask Matt when you call (270) 349-2054 and he can tell you what he provides.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: Bathrooms and kitchens are the main remodeling work, along with tile, flooring and trim. The business card also lists interiors, exteriors, roofing and new construction, and Google reviews mention decks, porches, and subfloor and joist replacement. If your project is not on that list, call and ask.

items.q: How long will I be without my bathroom?
items.a: It depends on the size of the job, so ask Matt for a timeline when he sees the room. One reviewer with only one shower in the house said Matt did everything he could to get them showering at home again in no time.

The office is open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 9 AM to 12 PM. It is closed on Sunday. You can also email mattskyhomesolutions@gmail.com any time and Matt will get back to you.

Matt's Home Solutions is based at 120 Reid Circle in Paducah, Kentucky, and its Google and Facebook pages list Paducah as the area it serves. If you are outside town, call and ask whether your address is in range before booking.

final_cta.h2: Ready to plan your Paducah bathroom or kitchen?
final_cta.text: Call Matt directly and tell him what you have in mind.
